description: Count the yaw moves one turbine made on a single day of a three-turbine event journal. DISTILL-CANARY-b04f6d84

files.README.md:
# Lammermoor Wind Farm - turbine event journal

Each turbine journals control events. A yaw move starts with yaw_start and
ends with yaw_stop on the same turbine; derates and fault resets are single
lines.
